हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: He had her love, but never valued it. Vaibhav and Sheena’s secret marriage turns into a story of betrayal, heartbreak, and regret. When Sheena finally walks away to choose self-respect, Vaibhav realizes the truth - but by then, it’s already too late.
